title: ledger_row/v1
description: One line of ledger.jsonl (primary cost profile) or ledger_stress_2x.jsonl (2x cost-profile re-simulation of the SAME recorded action trace - stored data, not an in-memory derivation, so MATH-5/MATH-6 checks run on bytes): bar-by-bar account state with the delta-NAV attribution terms STORED, not derived. NORMATIVE INVARIANT (CI, MATH-2): nav_micro[i] - nav_micro[i-1] == d_price_pnl_micro + d_funding_micro + d_fees_micro + d_liq_penalty_micro, exactly, in integer micro-units, every bar; cash changes only by realized components, to the unit. The ledger IS the equity curve; metrics.json references it rather than duplicating it.

ts.description: Bar close, REAL UTC epoch-milliseconds (bundle side).

turn.description: Decision-turn index whose holding bar this row closes (bar k, k >= 1, is turn k-1's holding bar). Null ONLY for the bar-0 opening row, which no turn's holding bar closes: it seeds the equity curve at run_config.starting_nav_micro with all four delta terms zero.

profile.description: Cost profile of this row's simulation (matches the containing file).

nav_micro.description: Net asset value at bar close, micro-quote.

cash_micro.description: Free cash at bar close, micro-quote.

realized_pnl_micro.description: Cumulative realized PnL including funding and fees since episode start, micro-quote.

d_nav_micro.description: NAV change over this bar, micro-quote. INVARIANT: equals the sum of the four attribution terms below, exactly.

d_price_pnl_micro.description: Mark-to-market price PnL component of the bar's NAV change, micro-quote.

d_liq_penalty_micro.description: Liquidation penalty component, micro-quote (0 except the terminal bar).

positions.description: Map: market alias -> position state at bar close. Per-market ledger from day one (multi-asset shape, Scope section 2). Flat markets appear with qty 0 and null price fields.

additionalProperties.description: One market's position state at bar close (the value of each positions map entry).

entry_px_ticks.description: Volume-weighted entry price, ticks; null when flat.

mark_px_ticks.description: Mark-price close of the bar, ticks.

liq_px_ticks.description: Liquidation trigger price, ticks; null when flat.

dist_to_liq_1e8.description: Distance to liquidation as a 1e-8 fraction of mark; null when flat.
